items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I was doing intermission with a pianist by the name of Jennie Dillard.

ctx.x: And the titles are "Loch Lomond," your big hit; "I'm Coming Virginia," "Annie Laurie" and "Blue Skies."
Yes. Well you see, I had gone in to the Onyx Club to work at that time. In fact, when I first came to New York, I was doing intermission with a pianist by the name of Jennie Dillard.
